tests.name: desktop NPC静态表情裁片按真实姓名切换，素世往返保留Live2D与阅读游标
390 NPC静态表情裁片按真实姓名切换，素世往返保留Live2D与阅读游标
320 NPC静态表情裁片按真实姓名切换，素世往返保留Live2D与阅读游标

execution.earlierSinglePortraitRuns: Previous single-image attempts and the corrected ShadowRoot hit-test diagnostic are not counted. All three final v2 scenarios passed on the finalBundle above.

assertions.identity: Actual contact names lin/林同学 and zhou/周同学 plus the saved seed's current DeepSeek-appearance encounter select the existing identity-derived appearance. Actual names are present in the controlled generation context.
assertions.imageSelection: Each NPC uses one fixed embedded PNG href; supported emotions select distinct viewBox rectangles. Three NPCs have distinct PNG href values.

pixelVerification.desktop: For each of three NPCs, all nine supported emotion viewBoxes and isolated SVG screenshot SHA-256 values are distinct.
pixelVerification.mobile: For each NPC at 320px and 390px, neutral/happy/angry/thinking have distinct viewBoxes and isolated SVG screenshot SHA-256 values.
pixelVerification.fallback: Undefined emotion produces exactly the neutral viewBox and the same screenshot SHA-256 for every NPC at every tested viewport.
pixelVerification.isolation: Surrounding UI and dialogue were temporarily hidden only during SVG screenshot sampling so text changes cannot produce a false portrait difference.

assertions.soyo: NPC presentation pauses/hides the existing Soyo portrait; the same canvas element remains mounted. Returning to Soyo restores ready status, visible opacity and the requested emotion. No additional NPC canvas appears.
assertions.unknownSpeaker: Unknown speaker shows neither a stale NPC portrait nor Soyo.
assertions.cursorAndState: Previous/next sentence navigation restores the correct speaker and portrait. Original story text and the full saved state remain unchanged by portrait navigation. Exactly one controlled generation occurs per scenario.
assertions.controls: ShadowRoot-aware hit tests confirm mode switch, location map, next sentence, composer and rescue control remain reachable.

visualReview.method: Actual saved screenshots opened with view_image: all 27 desktop expressions, all 24 mobile NPC/neutral-happy-angry-thinking scenes, and Soyo returning at all three sizes.
results: The three NPCs use consistent flat illustrated linework and fit the painted background; faces, brows, mouths and static hand gestures visibly change.
Each displayed frame contains one character. No adjacent atlas character or noticeable low-alpha preview debris was visible in the normal browser composition.
All reviewed heads and hair tops remain intact. Desktop and 390px views show the upper-body gestures.
320px uses the intended right-side bust crop: faces and raised thinking/waving hands remain visible; lower waist-level gestures can be below the dialogue edge.
No face is covered by the mode/map controls; reading, input and rescue controls remain separate.
Soyo returns as the existing real Live2D model after static NPC and unknown-speaker segments.
visualReview.clarifiedObservation: An initial concern about DeepSeek thinking/relieved hair-top clipping was checked against the actual screenshot pixels: 12/13 top rows are background, matching neutral/serious. The concern was a preview misreading, not a product defect; no frame or bundle change was needed.

boundaries.networkEvidence: No claim of a complete network capture across these cases. Tests explicitly verify the NPC image href values are embedded data URLs.
boundaries.pngPackagingAndInstallation: Owned by the parent agent and not asserted by this browser report.
